title: The first write that re-renders a board an older Intent rendered warns that an edit to a generated file is gone
body:
Found by ic on 2026-09-23 while re-reading the 3.2.1 CHANGELOG entries against HEAD, and confirmed by vc in the source at ca936e6c4. 0532 has landed (2e588c7cd) and is not yet deployed.

**What happens.** 0532 indents a multi-line board item's continuation lines. It taught `intent doctor` that a board rendered in the old shape is a stale render rather than skew: `views::skew` asks `board_rendered_before_0532` (views.rs:2367). The write path was not taught the same thing. `Facade::foreign_bytes` (facade.rs:17144) decides whether a file it is about to overwrite held bytes that were not the store's render. It excuses a difference only through `differs_only_in_renderer_owned_text` (facade.rs:17181), and never asks `board_rendered_before_0532` (views.rs:949).

So after an estate upgrades to a pair carrying 0532, the first write that re-renders a board view still in the old shape reports it as a lost edit. Any node's board write re-renders every board view, and so does a thread or issue write on a migrated board. The report reads `warning: overwrote bytes that were not the store's render -- an edit to a generated file is gone:` (render.rs:11227) and names the board. Nothing was edited and nothing is lost: the bytes were an older Intent's render. ic counted 14 boards in 7 estates that carry multi-line items, so the false alarm reaches every one of those estates on its first write after the second build all. This is 0385's false alarm again, arriving through the one predicate the write path does not share with doctor.

**What the fix has to do.** One predicate, "an older Intent rendered this", asked by both callers: `views::skew`, and `foreign_bytes` before it reports an overwrite. An old-shaped board is then re-rendered without a warning, and a hand edit in an old-shaped board is still reported by both. The drive: a board carrying a multi-line item, rendered by the pre-0532 shape, then any board write, which must print no overwrite warning and must still warn when the old-shaped board also carries a hand edit.

**Ruled (vc under hv's pen, 2026-09-23, under hv's decision 32): fixed in 3.2.1, in one bank with 0541, stacked on 0535 v4.** One predicate, "an older Intent rendered this view", lives in views and is asked by skew, foreign_bytes and organize's gate. The arm is `st new` over an older board with no warning, plus a control with a hand edit, which still warns. vc added one more change: 0532's doctor note stops naming Intent's issue number, because a reader in another estate cannot see Intent's ledger.

**MEASURED BEFORE THE FIX (dc, 2026-09-23).** The build was wt-0535's debug build at 02071ce4c, which carries 0532, run in a scratch project under an isolated HOME. cc's board held a multi-line item, and its `wip.md` was rewritten in the older shape. `intent st new` then printed "warning: overwrote bytes that were not the store's render -- an edit to a generated file is gone:", naming intent/whiteboard/cc/wip.md. The control, the board as rendered, printed none. `intent issues add`, `intent sync --to-disk` and `intent wb touch` each re-rendered the older board without a warning, so the false alarm was on the thread-mutation path (`apply_envelopes` into `foreign_bytes`). The drive is banked at refs/bank/dc/0539-0541/foreign2.sh.

**LANDED, NOT DEPLOYED (dc, 2026-09-23, on vc's word).** At a713eeb1f on 77e837b68 (0535 v4), from one bank for 0539 and 0541: refs/bank/dc/0539-0541/v1 (blob c195a5900), cut on 0535 v4's tree. `git apply --stat` reads 8 files changed, 197 insertions and 21 deletions. The patch-id read 99d3908bd on the blob, on the staged paths before the commit, and on the landed commit: the id vc judged. Over the twenty paths it and 0535 touch, HEAD equals the tail's judged tree cf898d342.


**THE FIX.** `views::rendered_by_an_older_intent(board, on_disk, rendered)` returns `Some(OlderRender::RendererOwnedText)` when only text the renderer owns differs. It returns `Some(OlderRender::BoardBefore0532)` when `board` is true and the view is in the pre-0532 shape. Otherwise it returns `None`. `views::node_board_view(project, path)` is the one test of a node's board view.
- Doctor's skew asks the predicate in its two stale-render arms.
- `foreign_bytes` asks it for every candidate path, so the write path excuses exactly what doctor excuses.
- Organize's removal gate asks it with `board` false, because its steps are thread and issue views. It says so where it asks.
- 0532's doctor note now reads "rendered by an older Intent (v{}; this binary renders v{}) -- only the indentation of a multi-line item's continuation lines differs, and any text the renderer owns; ...".

**THE ARMS.**
- A views unit test: the one question excuses the 0532 shape on a board and in no other view, and excuses renderer-owned text in every view. A hand edit in an older board is not an older render.
- intent-cli `a_multi_line_board_item_stays_one_item.rs`: `st new` over an older board prints no warning and re-renders the board in today's shape. The control, the older shape with a hand edit, is still named.
- wb_views_are_generated's 0532 arm asserts the reworded note: what differs, the verb that clears it, and no "0532".

**THE JUDGING.** dc's tail run on f155641bd, from 14:38:56Z to 14:55:47Z by date -u, over five banks: 0535 v4, 0539-0541 v1, and ic's 0540 v1, dtable v1 and 0538-tune v1. The base tree was 4a68a6489, HEAD's own. The bank tree was cf898d342, and every bank applied at its own patch-id.

- Rust: 3068/0/5 with the five banks, against 3055/0/5 at baseline. The +13 are 0535's ten arms and 0539+0541's three.
- bats: 743/743, with 1 skip, on both.
- fmt, clippy and doc: rc 0. app-test: 57 tests, 0 failures.
- Red sets: empty in both directions.
- The rlib grep found no member naming another worktree, and each side's own path was its control.

vc passed the run.

**DEPLOYMENT.** `native/rust/` deploys at hv's next `bin/devbin build all`, together with 0532, so no estate meets the false alarm: the first thread write over a board an older Intent rendered re-renders it with no warning.
